candidates.name: cJSON
candidates.version_notes: The code matches cJSON 1.7.x. It has the nesting limit of 1000, cJSON_Parse, the case-insensitive compare and the %1.15g/%1.17g number printing. The sources have no version string, so the exact version is unknown.

candidates.name: newlib
candidates.version_notes: Built by an Arm GNU toolchain (arm-15 jenkins path, likely Arm GNU Toolchain 15.x / newlib-cygwin). The exact newlib version is not given. The decompiled code looks like newlib-nano (non-reentrant-lite sbrk-based malloc, stubbed syscalls returning errno 0x58), but this is not confirmed.

candidates.name: libgcc (ARM soft-float / integer division helpers)
candidates.version_notes: Soft-float double-precision routines and thumb1 case helpers are linked in for a Cortex-M0-class target.

notes: The cJSON version is not determined. The newlib libc is probably the nano variant, which would need confirmation, e.g. from a vsnprintf/_svfprintf_float signature. The libgcc entries are identified only from the code structure; no libgcc strings are present.
